attempts.summary: Created LVM-backed volume vgdata/lvdata on node1 mounted at /srv/data, then grew it online from ~1.17GiB to ~2.34GiB while it remained mounted and its contents stayed intact (verified via sha256 checksums before/after). Since node1's disk (vda) was a single fully-used ext4 root with no spare block device, the PVs were built on loop devices backed by sparse files, with OpenRC persistence added so this survives reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a boot_id baseline, triggered a native reboot, polled until node1 reconnected, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV auto-activated, remounted, and data was intact post-restart.
